'''Executive Order 228''' was an order issued by the [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorran]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Darth Lachris]], which dictated that all civilians affiliated with the [[Balmorran resistance]] would be detained.
